provenance_note: Original editorial seed, not a comprehensive or expert-verified catalog. Definitions without review are explicitly flagged.

items.name: Independent Private Values
items.definition: An auction setting in which private bidder values are independently distributed.

items.name: Strong Exponential Time Hypothesis
items.definition: A fine-grained conjecture about the limiting exponential-time complexity of CNF satisfiability.

items.name: Submodular Valuations
items.definition: Valuations satisfying diminishing marginal returns.

items.name: XOS Valuations
items.definition: Valuations expressible as the maximum of additive valuations.

items.name: First-Price Auction
items.definition: An auction in which a winning bidder pays their own bid.

items.name: Second-Price Auction
items.definition: A single-item auction in which the highest bidder wins and pays the second-highest bid.

items.name: FPT
items.definition: Parameterized problems solvable in f(k) times a polynomial in the input size.

items.name: NP
items.definition: Decision problems whose YES instances admit efficiently verifiable polynomial-size certificates.

items.name: PPAD
items.definition: A total search complexity class based on a parity argument on directed graphs.

items.name: Bayesian Nash Equilibrium
items.definition: A strategy profile in an incomplete-information game where each type best responds in expected utility.

items.name: Coarse Correlated Equilibrium
items.definition: A distribution over actions with no profitable fixed unconditional deviation.

items.name: Correlated Equilibrium
items.definition: A distribution over actions such that following the mediator's private recommendation is incentive compatible.

items.name: Mean Field Equilibrium
items.definition: A consistency condition between agents' optimal responses and an aggregate population state.

items.name: Mixed Nash Equilibrium
items.definition: A mixed strategy profile with no profitable unilateral deviation in expectation.

items.name: Pure Nash Equilibrium
items.definition: A pure strategy profile with no profitable unilateral deviation.

items.name: Wardrop Equilibrium
items.definition: A nonatomic routing equilibrium where every used route has minimum available latency.

items.name: Smoothness Framework
items.definition: A technique to derive efficiency bounds from deviation inequalities, sometimes extending beyond pure equilibria.

items.name: Atomic Congestion Game
items.definition: A congestion game with finitely many indivisible players.

items.name: Congestion Game
items.definition: A game in which a player's cost depends on selected resources and resource congestion.

items.name: Mean Field Game
items.definition: A game model in which each agent responds to the distribution of a large population.

items.name: Nonatomic Congestion Game
items.definition: A routing or allocation game with infinitesimal agents, often represented by divisible flow.

items.name: Potential Game
items.definition: A game possessing a scalar potential that tracks incentives for unilateral deviations.

items.name: Bipartite Graph
items.definition: A graph whose vertices admit a partition into two independent sets.

items.name: Bounded-Treewidth Graph
items.definition: A graph from a family with a uniform bound on treewidth.

items.name: Forest
items.definition: An undirected acyclic graph.

items.name: Planar Graph
items.definition: A graph that admits a planar drawing with no edge crossings.

items.name: Tree
items.definition: A connected undirected acyclic graph.

items.name: Adversarial Online Model
items.definition: An online model in which an adversary can choose the request sequence.

items.name: Cell-Probe Model
items.definition: A data-structure complexity model that charges memory-cell accesses.

items.name: CONGEST Model
items.definition: A synchronous distributed model with bounded-size messages per edge per round.

items.name: LOCAL Model
items.definition: A synchronous distributed model with unbounded message size per round.

items.name: PAC Learning
items.definition: A distributional learning model requiring low generalization error with high probability.

items.name: Public-Key Encryption
items.definition: Encryption with separate public encryption and secret decryption keys.

items.name: Random-Order Model
items.definition: An online model in which a fixed multiset of requests arrives in uniformly random order.

items.name: Single-Machine Scheduling
items.definition: A scheduling environment with a single machine.

items.name: Zero-Knowledge Proof
items.definition: A proof protocol revealing no information beyond a statement's validity under a formal definition.

items.name: Approximation Ratio
items.definition: A performance guarantee comparing an algorithm's objective value with an optimum.

items.name: Graph Coloring
items.definition: Assign colors to vertices so adjacent vertices differ, often minimizing the number of colors.

items.name: Maximum Independent Set
items.definition: Find a largest pairwise nonadjacent vertex subset.

items.name: Minimum Vertex Cover
items.definition: Find a smallest vertex subset incident to every edge.

items.name: Budget Balance
items.definition: A constraint on a mechanism's aggregate transfers and payments.

items.name: Competitive Ratio
items.definition: A worst-case performance comparison between an online algorithm and an offline optimum.

items.name: Differential Privacy
items.definition: A bound on changes in output distributions under changes to one participant's data.

items.name: EF1
items.definition: Envy-freeness after deleting at most one good from the envied bundle.

items.name: EFX
items.definition: Envy-freeness after deleting any positively valued good from the envied bundle.

items.name: Incentive Compatibility
items.definition: An incentive constraint ensuring that agents prefer prescribed reporting behavior.

items.name: IND-CPA Security
items.definition: Indistinguishability of encrypted messages under chosen-plaintext attacks.

items.name: Individual Rationality
items.definition: A participation constraint relative to an agent's outside option.

items.name: Price of Anarchy
items.definition: Worst-case inefficiency of an equilibrium compared with an optimum under a specified equilibrium concept and objective.

items.name: Price of Stability
items.definition: Inefficiency of the best equilibrium compared with an optimum under a specified objective.

items.name: Regret
items.definition: A cumulative performance gap against a defined comparator class.

items.name: Truthfulness
items.definition: The incentive property that truthful reports are optimal under a specified strategic model.

items.name: VC Dimension
items.definition: A capacity measure given by the size of the largest shattered finite set.

items.name: Count-Min Sketch
items.definition: A compact randomized summary used to estimate item frequencies in data streams.

items.name: Linear Programming Relaxation
items.definition: Replace discrete constraints with linear constraints to obtain tractable bounds or rounded solutions.

items.name: Primal-Dual Method
items.definition: Design an optimization algorithm by maintaining related primal and dual solutions.

items.name: Randomized Rounding
items.definition: Use a random process to convert a fractional solution into an integral solution.
